reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified the compressor start relay/overload as the prime suspect while honestly keeping a failing compressor on the table, gave sensible unplugged-only checks (clean condenser, ventilation, direct socket, feel compressor temperature), asked efficient questions, and offered realistic repair-vs-replace economics and engineer escalation matching the ground truth.
